description: A transaction on Base (default) or Ethereum by hash: status (success, failed, pending), block and confirmations, sender and receiver, ETH value, fee, and every ERC-20 token transfer decoded with symbol and amount. Use it to confirm a payment landed. Costs USD 0.001 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); calls that fail are not charged.
